name: When should I consider a full remodel instead of basic smoke damage repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full remodel instead of basic smoke damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: If smoke damage is extensive, affecting structural elements, multiple rooms, or key areas like kitchens and bathrooms, it often presents an opportunity for a comprehensive remodel. Rather than simply repairing what was damaged, a full renovation allows for an integrated design-build approach to enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value. This is especially true if you've been considering updates or reconfigurations to your living spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Extensive smoke damage, particularly in key areas, can be an opportunity for a full remodel to enhance your home's functionality and value rather than just repairing the damage.
